title: Giving Advice and Responding to It

vocabulary.meaning_en: an opinion about what someone should do
vocabulary.note_ar: غير معدودة: لا نقول advices، بل some advice أو a piece of advice
vocabulary.note_en: Uncountable: never "advices"; say "some advice" or "a piece of advice".
vocabulary.example: Can I give you a piece of advice?

vocabulary.meaning_en: tell someone what you think they should do
vocabulary.note_ar: الفعل advise بحرف s ويُنطق /z/، والاسم advice بحرف c ويُنطق /s/
vocabulary.note_en: Verb "advise" (s sounds like /z/); noun "advice" (c sounds like /s/).
vocabulary.example: The doctor advised me to rest.
If I were in your shoes, I'd talk to the manager.
Have you ever considered working abroad?
It's time to knuckle down and study for the exam.

vocabulary.meaning_en: tell your employer officially that you are leaving your job
vocabulary.example: He handed in his notice and found a better job.
Stop moaning and do something about it.

vocabulary.word: give it a go / a try
vocabulary.example: I've never cooked fish, but I'll give it a go.

vocabulary.meaning_en: accept an offer or idea from someone
vocabulary.example: I think I'll take you up on that offer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: think very hard to find an idea or answer
vocabulary.example: I've been racking my brains for a solution.

vocabulary.meaning_en: your beliefs about what is right and wrong
vocabulary.example: That idea is not in line with my values.
I want everything to be above board.

fine_lines.title: advice vs advise
fine_lines.explanation_ar: advice اسم غير معدود (نصيحة)، وadvise فعل (ينصح). لا نقول advices أبدًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Advice" is an uncountable noun; "advise" is the verb. Never say "advices".

examples.sentence: She gave me some good advice.
I advise you to see a doctor.

fine_lines.title: Why don't you + verb vs How about + -ing
fine_lines.explanation_ar: بعد Why don't you نستخدم الفعل الأساسي، وبعد How about نستخدم الفعل بـ ing.
fine_lines.explanation_en: After "Why don't you" use the base verb; after "How about" use -ing.

examples.sentence: Why don't you look for another job?
How about looking for another job?

expressions.phrase: If I were in your shoes, I'd ...
expressions.meaning_en: Gives advice by imagining you are in their situation.
expressions.example: If I were in your shoes, I'd go to the doctor.

expressions.phrase: If I were you, I'd ...
expressions.meaning_en: A classic way to give advice.
expressions.example: If I were you, I'd talk to your teacher.

expressions.phrase: Have you ever thought of / about ...ing?
expressions.meaning_en: Suggests a new idea.
expressions.example: Have you ever thought of becoming a vet?

expressions.phrase: Have you ever considered ...ing?
expressions.meaning_en: Suggests an option to think about.
expressions.example: Have you ever considered retraining?

expressions.phrase: If I had that problem, I would ...
expressions.meaning_ar: لو كانت لديّ تلك المشكلة لـ ...
expressions.meaning_en: Gives advice by saying what you would do.
expressions.example: If I had that problem, I would seek professional advice.

expressions.phrase: Have you ever tried ...ing?
expressions.meaning_en: Suggests something the person may not have tried.
expressions.example: Have you ever tried talking to him face to face?

expressions.phrase: How about ...ing?
expressions.meaning_en: An informal suggestion.
expressions.example: How about studying for an hour every night?

expressions.phrase: Why don't you ...?
expressions.meaning_en: A common, friendly way to give advice.
expressions.example: If you're worried, why don't you go to the hospital?

expressions.phrase: I think it would be a good idea to ...
expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to recommend something.
expressions.example: I think it would be a good idea to call a plumber.

expressions.phrase: The sooner you ..., the better.
expressions.meaning_en: Says it's best to do something quickly.
expressions.example: The sooner you go to the doctor, the better you'll feel.

expressions.phrase: You have no choice but to ...
expressions.meaning_en: Strong advice: there is only one option.
expressions.example: You have no choice but to tell your boss.

expressions.phrase: That's a thought. / That's an idea.
expressions.meaning_en: A positive reply: "I hadn't thought of that".
expressions.example: Ask your neighbour for help? That's a thought.

expressions.phrase: I think I'll take you up on that.
expressions.meaning_en: Accepts someone's offer or advice.
expressions.example: You'll show me the gym? I think I'll take you up on that.

expressions.phrase: I'll give it a go. / I'll give it a try.
expressions.meaning_en: Says you will try the advice.
expressions.example: OK, I'll give it a go.

expressions.phrase: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.
expressions.meaning_en: A saying: you must try or take a risk to get something.
expressions.example: Apply for the job. Nothing ventured, nothing gained!

expressions.phrase: I hadn't thought of that.
expressions.meaning_en: Says the advice is new and useful.
expressions.example: Talk to him at the end of the week? I hadn't thought of that.

expressions.phrase: It's worth a try.
expressions.meaning_en: Says you are not sure it will work, but you will try.
expressions.example: It might not work, but it's worth a try.

expressions.phrase: That's a good / great idea.
expressions.meaning_en: A positive reply to advice.
expressions.example: That's a great idea! Thank you.

expressions.phrase: That's easier said than done.
expressions.meaning_en: A negative reply: the advice is hard to follow.
expressions.example: Talk to my boss? That's easier said than done.

expressions.phrase: That's all very well, but I'm not sure it would work.
expressions.meaning_ar: هذا جيد نظريًا، لكنني لست متأكدًا أنه سينجح.
expressions.meaning_en: Doubts the advice.
expressions.example: That's all very well, but I'm not sure it would work.

expressions.phrase: You have a point. I appreciate your advice, but ...
expressions.meaning_en: Politely agrees a little, then refuses.
expressions.example: You have a point. I appreciate your advice, but I'll wait a little.

expressions.phrase: I can see where you're coming from.
expressions.meaning_en: Says you understand someone's reasons.
expressions.example: I can see where you're coming from, but I disagree.

expressions.phrase: That's an interesting opinion, but I prefer to do it my way.
expressions.meaning_ar: هذا رأي مثير للاهتمام، لكنني أفضّل أن أفعلها على طريقتي.
expressions.meaning_en: Refuses advice politely.
expressions.example: That's an interesting opinion, but I prefer to do it my way.

expressions.phrase: That's not in line with my values.
expressions.meaning_en: Refuses advice because it feels wrong to you.
expressions.example: Thanks, but that's not in line with my values.

expressions.phrase: Thanks, but no thanks.
expressions.meaning_en: A short, slightly blunt refusal.
expressions.example: Work on the weekend? Thanks, but no thanks.

expressions.phrase: You can keep your advice to yourself.
expressions.meaning_en: A rude, angry reply; avoid using it.
expressions.example: He was angry and said, "You can keep your advice to yourself."

grammar.title: If I were you (second conditional)
grammar.explanation_ar: في الشرط الثاني نستخدم were مع كل الضمائر (If I were) ثم would + الفعل الأساسي. نستخدمه لتقديم النصيحة.
grammar.explanation_en: In the second conditional we use "were" with all subjects (If I were), then would + base verb. It is used to give advice.
examples: If I were you, I'd go to the doctor.
If I were in your shoes, I would call him.
If I had that problem, I would talk to a friend.

grammar.title: Verb patterns after advice phrases
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد حرف الجر (of / about) وبعد try وconsider وHow about نستخدم الفعل بـ ing. بعد would وWhy don't you نستخدم الفعل الأساسي. بعد It would be a good idea وno choice but نستخدم to + الفعل.
grammar.explanation_en: Use -ing after prepositions (of/about), "try", "consider" and "How about". Use the base verb after "would" and "Why don't you". Use "to + verb" after "It would be a good idea" and "no choice but".
examples: Have you ever thought of becoming a vet?
Why don't you look for another job?
I think it would be a good idea to call the plumber.

grammar.title: The sooner ..., the better
grammar.explanation_ar: تركيب the + صفة مقارنة ...، the + صفة مقارنة يعني: كلما ...، كلما ...
grammar.explanation_en: "The + comparative ..., the + comparative" shows that one thing changes with another.
examples: The sooner you start, the better.
The sooner you go to the doctor, the better you'll feel.
The more you practise, the easier it gets.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: Can I give you an advice?
Can I give you some advices?
Can I give you a piece of advice?
Can I give you a advise?
questions.explanation_ar: advice غير معدودة، فنقول a piece of advice.

questions.question: If I ___ you, I'd see a doctor.
questions.explanation_ar: في الشرط الثاني نقول If I were you.

questions.question: Have you ever thought of ___ a vet?
questions.explanation_ar: بعد حرف الجر of نستخدم الفعل بـ ing.

questions.question: Why don't you ___ for another job?
questions.explanation_ar: بعد Why don't you نستخدم الفعل الأساسي.
questions.explanation_en: After "Why don't you" use the base verb.

questions.question: Which is a POSITIVE response to advice?
questions.explanation_ar: It's worth a try تعني أنك ستجرّب النصيحة.
questions.explanation_en: "It's worth a try" means you'll try it.

questions.question: "That's easier said than done" means:
questions.explanation_en: It is hard to actually do.

questions.question: I think it would be a good idea ___ the electrician.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد It would be a good idea نستخدم to + الفعل.
questions.explanation_en: After "It would be a good idea" use to + verb.

questions.question: Which reply is RUDE and best avoided?
choices: You can keep your advice to yourself.
I can see where you're coming from.
questions.explanation_en: This reply is angry and rude.
